fullSheets.name: Cards 1
rows: Two and One clarification - if played on someone directly in front of you
Target Player may not be picked for X picks. Dice is rolled after the player is selected, must be played at the start of a round.  If unused card may be cashed in for 3 season points.

Selected Captain moves up one position in draft order for the upcoming round, card must be played at the start of the round. If you are draft spot 1-3 this card may be played as a "counterspell" instead.
Counter Spell (pick other captain, must agree)
counter spell, remove agree, streamline steps
scramble with range, possibly must include player above yourself
Target Player not be picked for X+(1,2,3) picks. Dice is rolled after the player is selected, must be played at the start of a round. Can only be played in rounds after draft round 2.
One target captain moves up two draft positions, if you are picks 1-3 you may shift two target captains down one space each instead.
down mega split 1 and 1 if last half
pick blocks now declared who and when, when played
Selected Captain moves down one position in draft order for the upcoming round, card must be played at the start of the round
Choose 2 other captains. If they both agree, target card played this round is negated. Pick Countered card at end of round
Choose 1 other captain, if they agree, counter target card played this turn. If they disagree, move down one draft position this round. Choose card at end of round

One target captain moves down two draft positions this round, the captain who played this card moves down one draft position in the next round. If you are last pick when playing this card, it only moves the target one slot.

Round order is scrambled for the round, may only be played after draft round 2. If the player is in draft positions 1-4 who plays this card, they maintain their position after the through the scramble.
Round order is reversed for the round, may only be played after draft round 2. If the player is in draft positions 1-4 who plays this card, they maintain their position after the through the reverse.

Target captain picks two players, captain who played this card then chooses one of them for the captain to take. Captain playing this card moves down one draft position for their next draft regardless of other draft cards

fullSheets.name: Draft Cards
rows: Select a group of five sequential players, they are scrambled. This action takes place before any other action during the action sequence. The player may not be the last player in the sequence unless they are last pick overall.
Target Player may not be picked for X number of picks, based on a dice roll. Captain who plays this card selects when the block activates. (Can pick any pick in the current round)

Selected Captain moves up one position in draft order for the upcoming round, card must be played at the start of the round. If you are in pick slots 5-8 when you play this card, this effect happens on a second action loop, following other cards.
For the Current round, your position may not be changed. This Effect activates before all other card effects besides "Scramble Round"

Target Player may not be picked for X number of picks, -1, +0, +1,+2, based on a dice roll and players choice. Captain who plays this card selects when the block activates. (Can pick any pick in the current round) Can not be played until after round 2
Counter one target card. This effect lasts through the duration of the action round, and the player may choose to counter any one target at time of activation.
Selected Captain moves down one position in draft order for the upcoming round.
One target captain moves up two draft positions, if you are picks 1-3 you may shift two target captains down one space each instead.

Target captain picks two players, captain who played this card then chooses one of them for the captain to take. Captain playing this card moves down one draft position for their next draft regardless of other draft cards

One target captain moves down two draft positions this round, the captain who played this card moves down one draft position in the next round. If you are last pick when playing this card, it only moves the target one slot.

Counter one target card. This effect may be used on any card effect happening prior, OR one effect of choice that will happen after. You must decide which effect to counter at the time of action in that case.
